scope: Staged B8 Kyushu geography only. Production activation, roster closure and full-world runtime gates remain separate.
coordinateMethod: Castle coordinates approximate the named historical site to two decimal degrees. They are authored reference pins, not survey measurements or modern reconstructed-tower corrections. District markers retain county direction but fit the unchanged outline at 40–180 world units from their parent. Castle pins remain unchanged even where nearby historical sites are less than 24 world units apart.
districtMethod: Nine provinces, fourteen prescribed castles and forty named counties or explicit county subdivisions total 1800000 koku. Plan14 weights determine resource values; they are gameplay abstractions, not historical tax estimates. County-to-castle assignments aggregate wider territories rather than claim exact jurisdiction.
ownershipMethod: Plan14 prescribes six Otomo, three Shimazu, two Ryuzoji, two Ito and one Sagara castle. Otomo assignments aggregate independent local houses, notably Kamachi at Yanagawa and Jo at Kumamoto. Usuki is explicitly brought forward from its documented 1562–1563 construction. Kokura models the prescribed regional stronghold. Its1560 Otomo placement is an abstraction, not the documented1569 Mori castle or1602 Hosokawa construction.
shimizuDecision: Shimizu denotes Kokubu's Osumi castle, not Kagoshima's earlier Satsuma residence. Kirishima municipal history describes the 1548 conquest and appointment of Shimazu Tadamasa. This site supplies the prescribed Osumi province without moving Kagoshima's namesake.
closeSiteBoundary: Plan14 section3.4 gives advisory 24 world-unit spacing. Plan14 D18 clarifies V13 requires unique coordinates, not minimum separation. Tonokori and Sadowara, and Muranaka and Hasuike, are historically nearby sites. The audit reports their close rounded pins rather than moving castles or changing acceptance constants.
routeMethod: Land costs use projected distance divided by90, rounded to0.5days; mountain edges multiply distance by1.5 before rounding. Sea seams retain canonical fixed costs. No direct Hitoyoshi–Hyuga edge exists. The network abstracts corridors and does not claim contemporary road survey accuracy.
